INSERT INTO quant_backtest_result ( strategy_id, from_date, to_date, trade_date, portfolio_value, return_pct, cash, equity ) VALUES
( #{item.strategyId}, #{item.fromDate}, #{item.toDate}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.portfolioValue}, #{item.returnPct}::numeric, #{item.cash}, #{item.equity} )
ON CONFLICT (strategy_id, from_date, to_date, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET portfolio_value = EXCLUDED.portfolio_value, return_pct = EXCLUDED.return_pct, cash = EXCLUDED.cash, equity = EXCLUDED.equity
